bio: Enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea at the Hilton Cambridge City Centre. Spoil yourself and indulge in a selection of freshly cut sandwiches before tucking into warm scones with clotted cream and jam.  Enjoy one of the United Kingdom's finest traditions, a scrumptious Afternoon Tea, served in the comfortable Piano Bar. Make your Afternoon Tea more special with sparkling wine or a Cambridge Gin cocktail.  Finish with sweet treats and your choosing from the fabulous range of Hope and Glory speciality teas. For those looking for bubbles, a glass of prosecco or free-flowing fizz can be added.
